_meta.openai/widgetDescription: Care checklist card: routine checks to ask about now, confirm, or already up to date, with the guideline source for each, questions grouped by clinician, a print button and a free save-to-Phi link.

description: Use this when the person you are helping has type 2 diabetes, kidney disease, lupus or a cancer history and wants to know which routine tests and checks may be due. It needs NO lab values, dates, names or records: only the condition, a few medicine classes, and for each routine test whether it was done recently (recent / overdue / never / unsure). It returns a prioritized list, the guideline source for each item (ADA, KDIGO, EULAR, AAO, NCCN, ESC), the questions to ask each doctor, and a one-page printable checklist. Decision support for visit preparation, not a diagnosis. Safe to use for a real person because you send only these closed options. Nothing is stored unless the person opens the save link: then only these options and the checklist are held for about 30 minutes for them to claim, and deleted if unclaimed.

conditions.description: The long-term condition(s) the person has. One or more of: type2_diabetes, kidney_disease, lupus, cancer_survivorship.

medications.description: Medicine classes the person takes, if relevant. Allowed: metformin, insulin, sulfonylurea, ace_inhibitor_or_arb, hydroxychloroquine, glucocorticoids.

test_status.description: For each routine test you know about: recent (done within its usual interval), overdue, never, or unsure. Omit tests you do not know; they are listed as 'not checked yet'. Test ids: a1c, uacr, egfr_creatinine, lipid_panel, dilated_eye_exam, foot_exam, vitamin_b12, liver_fibrosis_screen, cbc, electrolytes_potassium, bone_mineral_labs, urinalysis_urine_protein, lupus_activity_labs, hcq_retinal_screen, blood_pressure_check, vaccines_review, cardiac_function_test, thyroid_tsh, bone_density_scan, survivorship_follow_up, age_appropriate_cancer_screens, distress_screen.

treatment_exposures.description: For cancer survivorship only: past treatment types. Allowed: anthracycline_or_trastuzumab, chest_radiation, neck_radiation, aromatase_inhibitor_or_androgen_deprivation, immune_checkpoint_inhibitor.
